audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer calls this a FAV 4/10 matchup and gives Graves all seven phases at 6-8/10, while the content layer's own prose (whys, spikes, early/mid/late) describes a lane Graves loses after 6. The packet win rate is 36.84% and the packet levelChart is Kassadin / Graves / Graves / Skill / Kassadin / Skill / Kassadin.
audit.why: Two layers of the same matchup disagree, and the one that disagrees with the win rate is the full layer. The written advice is internally consistent with the packet chart, not with the 8/10 ratings.
audit.corrected: Difficulty set to UNFAV 7/10, carry threat 8/10, and both level charts aligned to the packet chart as one atomic group.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes described Riftwalk generically and never used its cooldown; the level-6 and 2+ item phases claimed Graves power that does not exist.
audit.why: Riftwalk is 5/3.5/2s — at rank 3 it is effectively a two-second reposition, which is the actual reason Graves' 425-range E and four-pellet spread stop connecting.
audit.corrected: Riftwalk's 5-to-2s spread written into spikes[1], spikes[3], whys[4], whys[6] and phases[4]; Graves' real spike restated as levels 2-3 plus first item, gated on Riftwalk being spent.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three factual errors repeated across many fields. (a) Null Sphere is said to SILENCE Graves and cut his Q mid-combo — Riot's text says it interrupts channels, there is no silence. (b) Smoke Screen is called a BLIND that makes Nether Blade autos miss — it reduces sight range and slows on impact, it does not cause misses. (c) Null Sphere's shield and Void Stone are said to blank Graves' burst — both are magic-only, and Graves' damage is physical.
audit.why: Riot's own descriptions are the authority: Q grants 'a temporary shield that absorbs magic damage', the passive 'takes reduced magic damage', and Smoke Screen 'reduces sight range'. A reader was holding autos for a debuff that never applies and fearing a shield that never touches his damage.
audit.corrected: Silence claims replaced with Force Pulse's slow and the reload/blink kite; blind claims replaced with the sight-range cut plus impact slow; magic-only shield and Void Stone stated as such, with Riftwalk named as the real reason Graves loses scaling. Graves' Q corrected from a 'wall-bounce return' to detonation on terrain contact.

audit.why: Riftwalk downtime is already the stated green light; only the number was missing and is now supplied.

audit.whatIsWrong: Graves' passive bullets cannot pass through units, so a Kassadin standing behind the caster minion takes a fraction of the spread — never stated.
audit.why: It is the mechanical reason 'point-blank' matters and why trading through the wave is worthless here.
audit.corrected: Folded into dosFull[0] and spikes[0] as the point-blank requirement.

edits.before: Levels 2-3 are the only part of this lane I own, so I have to be greedy with them. At Level 1 Kassadin can poke my short range with Null Sphere while I only have one ability up — concede that and just last-hit. The second I have my Q-E-W combo I want to E in for the point-blank 4-shell spread, drop Smoke Screen on him to blind his Nether Blade autos and gut his vision, and chunk him before his Null Sphere shield is leveled enough to soak it. He's a melee-range Kassadin with no Riftwalk and no escape right now; every trade I skip here is one I never get back, because his whole plan is to farm to 6 and never let me touch him again.
edits.after: Levels 2-3 are the only part of this lane I own, so I have to be greedy with them. At Level 1 Kassadin pokes my short range with Null Sphere from 650 while I only have one ability up — concede that and just last-hit. The second I have my Q-E-W combo I want to E in for the point-blank 4-shell spread, past the wave because my bullets do not pass through minions, drop Smoke Screen for the impact slow and the sight-range cut, and chunk him before his shield levels. He's melee with no Riftwalk right now; every trade I skip here is one I never get back, because his plan is to farm to 6 and never let me touch him again.

edits.before: This is where it slips away. Through 4-5 his Null Sphere shield starts absorbing a real slice of my shell burst and the silence shuts off my Q mid-combo, so I shift to shoving the wave and roaming on my E charges instead of forcing dying trades. Level 6 is the wall: Riftwalk means every time I E in to get my shells in range, he just blinks out of the spread, kites my two-round reload, and silences my Q before End of the Line ever detonates. My own R, Collateral Damage, is a real nuke, so the one line that works is baiting the blink first — make him waste Riftwalk, then commit Q-auto-R in the window before it resets. Commit into a charged Riftwalk and I dump my whole magazine into empty air.
edits.after: This is where it slips away. Through 4-5 his Null Sphere shield absorbs a slice of any magic I carry and Force Pulse slows me out of shotgun range, so I shift to shoving the wave and roaming on my E charges instead of forcing dying trades. Level 6 is the wall: Riftwalk at 5 seconds means every time my 425 E gets my shells in range, he blinks out of the spread, kites my two-round reload, and is back on me before End of the Line ever detonates. My own R is a real nuke, so the one line that works is baiting the blink first — make him spend Riftwalk, then commit Q-auto-R before it resets. Commit into a charged Riftwalk and I dump the magazine into empty air.

edits.before: Long game is lost and I have to be honest about it. Kassadin is a hard scaler built to ignore everything I do: his Null Sphere shield plus his innate magic-damage passive blank my shell burst, his low-cooldown Riftwalk makes my 4-shell short range and reload windows irrelevant, and his AP combo deletes me before True Grit's stacked armor and MR ever pay off — I stack the wrong resist against him anyway. My only path is to have already snowballed levels 2-3 into a CS and XP lead so brutal that his scaling never arrives, then group and use my E mobility to skirmish as a carry elsewhere. If he hits two items even, I cannot duel him — play for my team and never facecheck a Kassadin with Riftwalk up.
edits.after: Long game is lost and I have to be honest about it. Kassadin is a hard scaler built to ignore everything I do: his shield and Void Stone only blunt magic so they never touch my shells, but Riftwalk at rank 3 is a 2-second reposition that makes my short spread and reload windows irrelevant, and his AP combo deletes me before True Grit's armor ever pays off — my armor stacks are the wrong resist here anyway. My only path is to have already snowballed levels 2-3 into a CS and XP lead so brutal his scaling never arrives, then group and skirmish elsewhere on E mobility. At two items even I cannot duel him — never facecheck a Kassadin with Riftwalk up.
